source: owner measurements of the physical overlay; holes measured horizontally through the centre

measurements.feature: overall width at the tabs flanking the lower outermost small lamp holes
measurements.traced_basis: outer outline width at y -20..-25 (lamp_l2/lamp_r2 at y about -20)

finding: Overall scale is right (0.55 %, inside tape-measure error). The traced HOLES are small by a near-constant 1.4-1.7 mm per side, i.e. an edge offset in the hole tracing, not a scale error. The x1.035 global rescale proposed earlier the same day is WITHDRAWN.
decision: No rescale. overlay_mm.json keeps the traced holes; true stock hole edges are about 1.55 mm further out (stock_hole_offset_mm).

effect_on_new_overlay.tach_hole: screen-limited: traced x0.887 gives r 34.87 vs the 2.8in visible r 35.06 (0.19 mm margin). The true-proportion hole (r 36.1) would show a dead ring, so the hole stays as is. Consider r about 34.3 for assembly tolerance.
effect_on_new_overlay.speedo_hole: screen-limited: traced x0.86 gives r 43.47 vs the 3.4C visible r 43.80. True proportion (r 44.9) would exceed the screen; stays as is.
effect_on_new_overlay.temp_fuel_holes: full size on the 5in. Growing them by 1.55 mm would push past the assumed 5in active area (temp by 3 mm^2, fuel 0.2 mm^2), so they stay as traced unless the 5in active-area position is confirmed.

facts_that_use_the_true_hole_sizes: 2.8in tach visible O70.1 in the 81.5 mm stock hole: about 5.7 mm per side to spare
3.4in tach visible O87.6 covers the 81.5 mm stock tach hole by about 3.0 mm per side
bare 4.0in O101.5 does NOT cover the 104.4 mm stock speedo hole (about 1.45 mm per side short)
